name: Riverbanks Zoo & Garden
where: 500 Wildlife Pkwy, Columbia, SC 29210 - I-126 exit 1 (Greystone Blvd), ~1 mi
cost_note: Online: adults (13-61) $27.95 x2, children (2-12) $24.95 x2, parking $3 = $108.80 + tax; window prices $3/ticket and $3 parking higher. Rides extra on a cashless Explore More Card ($1=1 EC): Sky-High Safari ropes climb 9 EC (min 48 in without parent), Tiny Trailblazers 5 EC (max 48 in), train/carousel 3 EC. No outside food.

facilities.name: Zoo & Garden gates (winter hours Nov 2 - Jan 31)

kid_notes: Large walking zoo plus river-side botanical garden reached by the Saluda Skyride; 44-ft Sky-High Safari ropes course suits the 9-year-old (6-year-old only if 48 in+ or with parent), kangaroo walk-through, giraffe feeding. Closed only Thanksgiving and Christmas Day per operator, so Wed 25 Nov falls in normal winter hours. Zipline (Zip the Zoo / ZOOm the River) not listed on current rides page - could not determine if still operating.

name: Sesquicentennial State Park (Sesqui)
where: 9564 Two Notch Rd, Columbia, SC 29223 - I-20 exit 74 (US-1 Two Notch Rd), ~3 mi NE
coord_source: OSM/Nominatim park centroid (entrance is on US-1)
cost_note: $6 adults x2 + $3.50 children 6-15 x2 = $19. Kayak $10/h, pedal boat $15/h (seasonal - could not determine if offered in late Nov).
kid_notes: 30-acre lake with ~1.9-mi mostly flat Sandhills Trail loop, 3.5-mi Loop Road Trail, 0.4-mi Jackson Creek nature trail, 6.1-mi mountain-bike loop (bring bikes), two playgrounds in the picnic area. Splash pad closed for the season.

name: Saluda Shoals Park (Leo's Landing playground + riverside trails)
where: East entrance 6071 St Andrews Rd / West entrance 5605 Bush River Rd, Columbia (Irmo), SC 29212 - I-26 exit 106 (St Andrews Rd) to east entrance, rough few miles
cost_note: $7 per car/minivan daily parking (2026 ICRC page; older pages say $5).
kid_notes: Leo's Landing inclusive playground at the east entrance; ~10 miles of paved/unpaved trails along the Saluda River. Closed only Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day per ICRC. Splash pad is summer-only.

name: Urban Air Trampoline & Adventure Park - Columbia
where: 1120 Bower Pkwy, Columbia, SC 29212 (Harbison) - I-26 exit 103 (Harbison Blvd), ~1 mi
cost_note: Unlimited Play $29.99 x2 kids + required socks $4.99 x2 = $69.96 before tax; Unlimited Play+ (with go-karts) $39.99; parent ticket $14.99 if adults play. Waiver required.
kid_notes: Trampolines, warrior course, ropes course, indoor Sky Rider zipline, climbing walls, mini go-karts. BUT regular Wednesday hours start 16:00 - outside a 10:30-13:30 lunch window. Page says 'No holiday hours scheduled at this time' and that hours may change for school breaks; call before counting on a midday opening.

name: Congaree National Park (Boardwalk Loop)
where: 100 National Park Rd, Hopkins, SC 29061 - I-77 exit 5 then SC-48 ~20 mi (dead-end spur)

facilities.name: Grounds / boardwalk
facilities.note: Park open 365 days; boardwalk reported open year-round

kid_notes: 2.6-mi boardwalk loop through old-growth floodplain forest. Confirmed as a known +2h45 dead-end spur from the corridor; not re-researched further. NPS hours page fetch returned no hours text; visitor center hours come from an undated NPS news release (closed Thanksgiving Day). A third-party listing mentions boardwalk reconstruction 'by summer 2026' - status not confirmed by NPS.

name: Aiken State Park
where: 1145 State Park Rd, Windsor, SC 29856 - ~16 mi east of downtown Aiken; no direct I-20 exit (measure from I-20 exit 22 or 33)
cost_note: $3 adults x2 + $1 children 6-15 x2 = $8. Canoe/kayak rental on 1.7-mi Edisto canoe trail needs 24 h advance booking via office.
kid_notes: Spring-fed lakes, 3-mi Jungle Nature Trail (boardwalk section CLOSED per park alert; flooding closed portions), playground listed on trail/facility pages, canoe trail on the South Fork Edisto. Rural - bring picnic.

name: Hitchcock Woods
where: Entrances incl. South Boundary Ave SW and 263 Rubins Cottage Ln (off Dibble Rd), Aiken, SC - I-20 exit 18 (SC-19) ~8 mi south
kid_notes: 2,100-acre urban forest with deep-sand horse trails, the Sand River and Memorial Gate; a foundation kids' scavenger hunt used a 1.5-mi loop from the Stable on the Woods entrance (sandy, hilly). No public restrooms or water. Hunt season (Oct 15-Mar 15) restricts dog walking Tue 13:30-17:00 / Sat mornings only - Wed unaffected. Horses have right of way.

name: Hopelands Gardens & Rye Patch
where: 1700 Whiskey Rd, Aiken, SC (adjoins Hitchcock Woods) - I-20 exit 18 (SC-19) ~8 mi south
kid_notes: 14-acre estate garden with paths, lily ponds and lawns; pairs with Hitchcock Woods next door for a longer outing. Short on its own for active boys. City of Aiken page returned 403 to me; hours from Visit Aiken / search snippet. Street address from general knowledge - verify.

name: Phinizy Swamp Nature Park (Phinizy Center for Water Sciences)
where: 1858 Lock and Dam Rd, Augusta, GA 30906 - I-20 exit 196A to I-520, exit 10 (Doug Barnard Pkwy), ~1.5 mi

facilities.name: Visitor Center / Swamp Shop
facilities.note: Volunteer-staffed; hours not published - call ahead

kid_notes: Open 365 days per operator. Beaver Dam Trail ~0.5 mi, Pond Trail 0.8 mi loop (alligators sometimes), two short boardwalks with covered observation deck, 25-ft bridge over Butler Creek; covered Pfizer Pavilion for picnics. Boardwalk total is short (~0.2 mi), so a 75+ min visit means combining loops. Old domain phinizyswamp.org no longer resolves.

name: Savannah Rapids Park & Augusta Canal headgates / towpath
where: 3300 Evans to Locks Rd, Martinez, GA 30907 - I-20 exit 199 (Washington Rd) ~5 mi north (rough)
kid_notes: Playground, river rapids overlook, canal headgates and the packed-dirt Augusta Canal towpath (just under 6 mi to Lake Olmstead). Towpath was closed after Hurricane Helene; Nov-Dec 2025 sections reopened (headgates to I-20 ~1.5 mi), Jan 2026 maintenance closures, May 2026 report says trails reopened with more work pending FERC review (WRDW). Current status of the headgates segment could not be confirmed for Nov 2026.

name: Riverwalk Augusta (+ Oglethorpe Park playground)

facilities.name: Riverwalk
facilities.note: Explore Georgia lists 24 h; a third-party listing says weekdays 8-5 (likely wrong)

kid_notes: Brick river promenade with playground areas (Oglethorpe Park at 6th St has climbing equipment); right next to downtown Broad St lunch spots. Probably under 75 min on its own; Augusta Canal Discovery Center (Tue-Sat 9:30-15:00, $14 adult) is a museum add-on with Nov boat tours by call (706-823-0440).
